decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 21.20 EUR for the disputed charge only. TXN-008169 is a 21.20 EUR charge from Kestrel Athletic Club on card CRD-000094, made on 2026-09-26 and posted on 2026-09-27. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 32 days after posting, which is inside the 120-day time limit (time-limits). Kestrel Athletic Club's cancellation confirmation (DOC-000087) says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-12. That is before the 2026-09-26 charge, so the charge should not have been made (recurring-cancelled-before-charge). The cardholder asked for 84.80 EUR, which covers four months of charges. Only TXN-008169 is in dispute, and the credit can never be more than the disputed charge (provisional-credit), so the larger claim does not change the amount. 21.20 EUR is well under the 3,000.00 EUR limit for automated credit.
